title: R0 静止极限：R5068（种群核心的 32 态 Lindblad 轨迹）
derivation: m → ∞ (mass ×10⁶, 1e-3 µK) holds the atom at the focus: the motion decouples and the quantum-jump ensemble's mean is the Lindblad equation there, which the population core solves for the same model (static request) to its estimated error.

info.coreMethod: Full32 density-matrix Lindblad dynamics on the folded Fourier lattice (explicit charges by mixing, seed amplitude and ring condition, and their ring; far harmonics folded statically, the pieces negligible over the run left out): one rational Krylov space from the initial state and its translations, every output read from one Galerkin reduced model, each output's error estimated by its change between consecutive checkpoints
